title: Challenges
description: A Minecraft Challenges Mod. You have multiple challenges to choose from for example shared damage with all players, randomizer (every block drops a random item) and more.
body:
## Setup:
**Make sure to have the Support Mods [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) & [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) installed aswell!** ‼️

## Features:
A Minecraft 26.x fabric mod that adds a challenge system to the game. Open /challenges to bring up the menu, pick a challenge, and it changes how the game plays. Challenges can be combined with the randomizer for extra chaos.

## Challenges:

**Randomizer** - Every mined block drops a random new Item. E.g you mine a grass block and you get a Stone block (or skmething different)

**Shared Life** — every player shares damage. if one player gets hit, every other player takes the exact same amount.

**Jump Item** — every time you jump, a random item drops at your feet.

**Ice Trail** — press sneak to toggle an ice platform that follows you wherever you go. a 3x3 patch of ice spawns under you every tick, only on air so it won't replace existing blocks. works on foot and in boats.
